description_en: Grants or revokes specified tenant roles for a user in the current tenant based on the account ID. The request parameters list the roles to be granted and revoked separately. If an eligible account has not joined the tenant, the operation adds the user first
description_zh: 按账号 ID 为当前租户中的用户授予或撤销指定租户角色。入参分别列出待授予和待撤销的角色。符合条件的账号尚未加入租户时，接口会先添加用户
name: UpdateTenantUserRoles

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user account in the MaxCompute tenant
parameters.help_zh: MaxCompute 租户下的用户账号 ID
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.help_en: The list of tenant role names to be granted to the user
parameters.help_zh: 要为该用户授予的租户角色名称列表
parameters.name: grant

parameters.help_en: The list of tenant role names to be revoked from the user
parameters.help_zh: 要从该用户撤销的租户角色名称列表
parameters.name: revoke

data.description_en: The returned data. The value is success if the operation is successful

errorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails
errorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时返回的错误码

errorMsg.description_en: The error message returned when the request fails
errorMsg.description_zh: 请求失败时返回的错误信息

httpCode.description_en: The HTTP status code of the request
httpCode.description_zh: 本次请求的 HTTP 状态码

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the API request, which can be used to troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 本次 API 请求的唯一标识，可用于排查调用问题

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The user account and the tenant roles to be granted or revoked
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 用户账号及要授予、撤销的租户角色
v1_body_parameters.name: body
